Remarks

This receiver establishes a connection to a SignalR hub and listens for messages of type T. It includes built-in debouncing to prevent rapid-fire message handling and supports automatic reconnection. The receiver listens for messages on a method named "Consume_{TypeName}" where {TypeName} is the name of type T.

Remarks

This receiver establishes a connection to a SignalR hub and listens for messages of type T. It includes built-in debouncing to prevent rapid-fire message handling and supports automatic reconnection. The receiver listens for messages on a method named "Consume_{TypeName}" where {TypeName} is the name of type T.

Properties

DebounceDelay

Gets or sets the debounce delay to prevent rapid-fire message handling. Default is 1000 milliseconds (1 second).

public TimeSpan DebounceDelay { get; set; }

Property Value

TimeSpan

Remarks

When multiple messages arrive in quick succession, only the last message within the debounce window will trigger the MessageReceived event.

Methods

ConnectAsync()

Establishes a connection to the SignalR hub and starts listening for messages.

public Task ConnectAsync()

Returns

Task

A task representing the asynchronous connect operation.

Remarks

If already connected, this method returns immediately without creating a new connection. The connection is configured with automatic reconnection enabled. Messages are received on a method named "Consume_{TypeName}".

DisconnectAsync()

Disconnects from the SignalR hub and disposes the connection.

public Task DisconnectAsync()

Returns

Task

A task representing the asynchronous disconnect operation.

Remarks

This method also cancels any pending debounce operations.

Dispose()

Disposes the receiver, disconnecting from the hub and releasing all resources.

public void Dispose()

Remarks

This method cancels any pending debounce operations and synchronously disposes the hub connection.
